question: What does 21 CFR 820.10 require?
answer_raw: 21 CFR 820.10 requires that a manufacturer subject to this part must document a quality management system that complies with the applicable requirements of ISO 13485 (incorporated by reference, see § 820.7) and other applicable requirements in this part. The requirements include (a) Document, which requires the manufacturer to document a quality management system that complies with ISO 13485 and other applicable requirements. (b) Applicable regulatory requirements, which include compliance with ISO 13485 Clause 7.5.8, 7.5.9.1, and 8.2.3, 8.2.3, and 8.3.3, as well as the requirements of part 803 and 806. (c) Design and development, which applies to class II, class III, and class I devices listed in paragraph (c)(1) of this section and table 1 to paragraph (c)(2) of this section, requiring compliance with ISO 13485 Clause 7.3 and its subclauses. (d) Devices that support or sustain life, which applies to devices that support or sustain life and require compliance with ISO 13485 Clause 7.5.9.2. (e) Enforcement, which requires that failure to comply with any applicable requirement renders a device adulterated under section 501(h) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
